GET /api/agent/projects/{project_id}/tas.notes: Flat-list contract (count, data, ordering, visibility filtering) for the agent tasks list endpoint. test_list_tasks_includes_children_inline in test_agent_strategic_fetch.py is exempt because it tests the children inline field — a different response aspect — rather than duplicating the flat-list contract.

GET /api/admin/projects/{project_id}/com.notes: Compute-job listing response shape (compute_jobs array, vm_phase, provisioning_cause, pagination) owned here. Tests in test_admin_routers.py TestComputeJobsPanel are class methods invisible to the scanner and cover narrower field-level assertions.

GET /api/admin/activity.notes: Activity feed response shape (pr_impact_annotations, failure_class, artifact fields) owned here. The five test_digest.py functions are pre-existing co-located tests that exercise the same endpoint from the digest angle and are exempted to preserve their coverage.

GET /api/admin/pipeline-efficiency.notes: Pipeline efficiency snapshot response shape owned here. No other test file references this endpoint.
